entry.title: DUSK v0.4.2
entry.content:
## Changes
- Combat logic reworked: the combat_logic option now has three settings, from easiest to hardest: - easy (new default): the logic expects the most guns, earliest. Episode 1 needs 1 gun from E1M3 and 2 from E1M6. Episode 2 needs 2 from E2M2 and 3 from E2M6. Episode 3 needs 3 from E3M2 and 4 from E3M6. - normal: one gun fewer at every step. Episode 1 needs 1 gun from E1M6. Episode 2 needs 1 from E2M2 and 2 from E2M6. Episode 3 needs 2 from E3M2 and 3 from E3M6. - unhinged: no combat logic. You may play a long time with only the sickles. - Each episode’s first level never needs a gun. Secret levels need as many as the end of their episode. The Sword doesn’t count as a gun. - E2M1 developer pickups removed: a hidden developer stash in E2M1 (16 extra blue keys and a sword) is no longer part of the randomizer. That’s 17 fewer checks. E2M1’s real blue key is now named E2M1 - Blue Key. - Linux, Steam Deck and macOS setup: the Setup Guide now has install instructions for each system, including Steam Deck with native Linux or Proton. These platforms haven’t been tested in game yet, so reports are welcome.
## Fixes
- Build: fixed a build error introduced in 0.4.1. It only affected people building the mod themselves.
## Upgrading
- Update both dusk.apworld and the mod ZIP. - YAML changes for combat_logic: - normal used to mean the strictest rules. That setting is now called easy, and normal now has the looser rules that used to be called lenient. If your YAML says combat_logic: normal and you want the old behaviour, change it to easy or remove the line. - lenient and none still work. They now mean normal and unhinged. - If your YAML refers to E2M1 - Blue Key 1 (for example in exclude_locations), rename it to E2M1 - Blue Key.

entry.content:
# QOL Features ### New Player options: - Various player options have been renamed and reorganized for ease of reading - Casanova Mode: sets the game to “Casanova mode”, allowing the player to kiss many of the enemies around the apartment complex. Each smooch is a location. - Include Final True Ending Equipment: When set to false, items exclusive to the Final True ending boss battle will be excluded from the item pool - Locations that are granted automatically by taking mutually exclusive actions now send in-game messages upon being granted.
## New Goal Option Changes - Completing a perfect ritual no longer counts as completing a flawed or partial ritual for goal purposes - XIN-AMON and Eternal fate endings still count as Flawed Ritual endings - Failed Ritual (zero correct offerings) is now differentiated from Flawed Ritual, and Mask Ending counts as a Failed Ritual - Overhauled “Goal” player option to be a set of goals that the player can mix and match - "Failed Ritual": Go to the roof without giving the astronomers any correct offerings - "Flawed Ritual": Give the astronomers at least one correct offering and defeat them on the roof - "Perfect Ritual": Give the astronomers all four correct offerings and defeat them on the roof - "Screaming Sky Ending": Give the astronomers all four correct offerings and flee from their final form on the roof - "Promise Ending": Give the astronomers all four correct offerings and defeat them on the roof after making a promise to Sybil - "Mask Ending": Give the astronomers all four weird offerings and face the Masked Shadow on the roof - "XIN-AMON Ending": Give three correct offerings and a Guinea Pig to Beryl, and then defeat XIN-AMON on the roof - "Eternal Fate Ending" - Give the Guinea Pig as any offering and face it on the roof - "Unity Ending" - Kill Sybil and enter the red door in the observatory to learn the truth - "Final True Ending" - Give the astronomers all four correct offerings, defeat them on the roof, then unleash the true power of your Meteor Strike! - "Words of Power Ending" - Complete all crosswords for the secret key, then accept Wilhelmina’s offer in the Tomb of Crosswords - “Smooch the Sultan” - Power up by kissing 49 or more enemies and then give the Sultan of Kissing a kiss (selecting this goal activates Casanova Mode + locations) - "Smooch The Visitor" - Give the astronomers all four correct offerings, defeat them on the roof, then give the Visitor a kiss :3. (selecting this goal activates Casanova Mode + locations)
# Client Changes - Removed ._DS_Store artifacts from zip file - Fixed bug where item name was not displayed and location was not rewarded for "Apt. 12 Walls Large Room - Item on East Table" - Fixed bug where the randomized item at location "Apt. 12 Planetarium - Item in North Closet" replaced the exit door instead of the intended item. - Fixed bug where item grant message would not be sent for “Landlord Hell South Hall - Slay Gatling” - Fixed bug where “Fungus Maze Depths - Spore Guardian Audrey Loot” would not be correctly rewarded upon defeating the Spore Guardian with Audrey already in your party - Fixed some missing or swapped item icons - Added missing text for “Ease Regrets” option that revives Spine - Added “Ease Regrets” option that revives the Minesweeper - Removed trigger that permanently disables the blackout event when walking through the door to the roof - Removed vanilla “Custom Gun” drop from Nestored Eugene - Fixed bug where Elevator Freak would die upon player running away from combat - Also removed vanilla game behavior where player would be transferred to the basement floor upon running away from the Elevator Freak - Fixed bug where the incorrect variable was being tracked to check whether or not Colonel Squeakums had been killed for both Ernest’s “Ease Regrets” option and the location "Ernest's Hideout - Slay Colonel Squeakums"
# Apworld Changes - Cleaned up print statement that was sending out irrelevant info during world generation - “Apt. 28 Twilight - Slay Piranha Guy” is no longer considered a Friendly Fire location as Piranha Guy dies no matter what the player does - Fixed logic bug where the game assumed players were able to enter stairwell from ground floor before placing any planet discs in the stairwell sockets - Fixed logic bug where Basement Key wasn’t considered a requirement to reach Apt. 25 (Dan’s Apartment) - Fixed logic bug where game assumed players didn’t need any extra herbicide to traverse inner Apartment 12 - Fixed logic bug where “Audrey” was not considered a required item for some Audrey Loot locations - Fixed logic bug where “Guinea Pig” was not considered a required item for "Security Room - Slay Cinnamon" - Fixed logic bug where the ability to face Garbage Worm on ground floor was not considered a requirement for “Basement Utility Room - Item Dropped by Garbage Worm” - Removed glitch world keys from the item pool when mask offering areas are disabled in settings - Fixed logic bug where only two “yellow key” items were considered necessary to traverse glitch world, when the game requires three. A third key will also be added to the item pool in seeds that include glitch world locations. - Fixed other glitch key counts that were larger than the amount of corresponding locks; the item pool now only contains as many glitch world keys as there are glitch world locks - Landlord Hell East - Slay Gatling is now assigned to the correct Landlord apartment phase in logic - Updated locations and removed duplicate locations corresponding to slaying the Basilisk in Meat World Eyeball and picking up the item where the Ocular Tetherblade would be in vanilla - Split singular locations for enemies fought in a group into multiple in cases where the vanilla game has separate variables tracking whether they have been killed - In the locked room of Vincent’s apartment: “Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Eye Monsters” has been split into "Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Eye Legs", "Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Eye Shoulder", and "Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Wiggle Eye" - Because of this, Eye Shoulder is now fightable on all difficulties - In the west bedroom of Vincent’s apartment: "Apt. 37 Bedroom - Slay Onlookers" has been split into "Apt. 37 Bedroom - Slay Onlooker 1" and "Apt. 37 Bedroom - Slay Onlooker 2" - Other new locations: - “Eugene's Shop - Gift From Nestor's Head” (Gift given upon interacting with a freshly Nestored Eugene) - “Fred's Apt. - Gift from Fred” (gift given upon first speaking to the fake Fred/facetaker)

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r3
entry.content:
It's time for some new features! The main things are adding Unique Units and Unique Buildings to the itempool. I've also made an "AP World" Civilization with no UU/UB/starting techs as part of the eventual "blank slate" I want (though adding traits to the itempool appears to be much harder than I thought). This is very much a first draft of the feature (especially UBs), so make sure to read the notes before using them.
### Changelog: - Added options to add Unique Units and Unique Buildings to the itempool. The way it works is to randomly add as many as it can as "useful" items. - Added an AP World Civilization, so you can properly use Unique Building items and not break logic with starting techs--it's meant to be used with unrestricted leaders, and I'm also not sure if the AI can roll into that Civ randomly (something I want to change if it can). - Fixed a typo that caused the Great Spy item to spawn a regular spy instead.
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel). 5. The "AP" Unique Units can't be upgraded into, though they can be upgraded themselves. This is planned to be fixed in an upcoming update. 6. AP Unique Buildings are programmed assuming you don't have a "natural" Unique Building for your Civilization for purposes like avoiding duplicates of the same class of building, so if you use a Civilization other than AP World things could break. 7. If a building has a requirement to be built (such as the University), and you build an AP Unique Building version of it (such as the Seowon), you aren't able to build the original version anymore. There's no reason why you'd need to do this (the only vanilla building that's not strictly worse than the UB alternatives is the Theatre/Hippodrome, and that doesn't suffer the bug), but it's weird behavior.
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet. 4. If you add Unique Buildings to the itempool, it causes a noticeable amount of lag when entering the city screen in some cases (due to the coding I need to make them work how I want them to). I think it scales with the amount of cities you have, but it also might be just a memory leak. If you experience this lag (or don't and think you would), let me know!
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

entry.title: Animal Crossing v0.5.0
entry.content:
Setup instructions: https://github.com/randomouscrap98/AP_ACGC_PC/blob/master/docs/setup_en.md Game info: https://github.com/randomouscrap98/AP_ACGC_PC/blob/master/docs/game_info_en.md
This is the last version with breaking changes; future versions should be fully backwards compatible with seeds made from this version onwards, unless otherwise stated.
## New features - **New goals: Furniture Set + Chess Set**. Items go into the pool, you must set up the set in your house - **Tracker page for furniture + chess set**. Shows when an item was received from the pool + whether it is detected in your house - **Extra bells option**. On top of bell credits which automatically apply to your loan, you can also just get money directly in the mail. Careful, set this too high and you'll get a LOT of mail - **Fossil Loans option**. Make sure you can make a lot of money each day before getting later progressive house loans - **Shops never sell out option**. Useful for flowers, etc - **Render scale + fixed scaling**. Rendering now works more like an emulator, which should feel familiar - **Version-aware slot data**. Slot data is versioned with a compatibility layer; should have backwards compatibility from now on (update software, use on old seed). Forward compatibility is blocked for safety; won't let you play new seeds on old game - **Nook tells you he's waiting on progressive house**. To reduce confusion - **Better config experience**. Config is created at startup with expected structure, game starts even with invalid config, more error messages
## Bugfixes - (Old PC port bug): Rain should no longer crash the game randomly. For those of you on linux, you shouldn't see random textures fly across the screen during rain anymore - Nook store never renovated with timesanity + early morning - Mole cricket and pill bug now require the shovel in logic - Butterflies no longer get stuck in a tight circle (particularly bad for purple butterflies) - Offline json no longer wraps to unexpected values for out of range ints
## Tweaks - Better dynamic critters: more pond fish in pond, more bug spawns, etc - No museum items in pool if museum goal is not on - AP trackers moved to AP submenu (sorry, was getting too long) - MSAA off by default (not needed with new auto render scale) and doesn't require a video reset to change - Resetti disabled by default (you can turn him on anytime) - Borderless acres disabled by default (you can turn them on anytime) - Line tweaks to letters - Moved options around in options creator: - Each sanity now has its own group - Settings which work regardless of whether the related sanity is on or off moved out of sanity groups - New "Matters of Money" group for money options that work all the time - New "Goal" group for everything related to goals. Some sanity options (completion % etc) moved here (weren't actually related to sanity, only to the goal) - Clear generation error when no check is doable at start - Example yamls as individual files

And with this, Verdania is fully mapped and every area is done (on a base level). Split directions and enemy mapping are being worked on but the totals are looking incredible, shoutouts to the mappers for being crazy productive people. Anyway here's another week full of logic adjustments, bug fixes and some new features (Also usual small offer to [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) if you feel like supporting this)
# Major
- Added completed Verdania logic (by Pyxl) - Completely reworked Slabs logic (by Maya) - Completely reworked Choral Chambers logic (by Gallos) - Several other areas got logic updates as well - Added the Split/Directional Abilities category, Damage Boost Logic and Platforming Capability got expanded to now include Elite Ball Knowledge (which is Proficient Movement + extremely specific game knowledge that even Proficient Movement doesn't cover) - Added optional Left/Right versions of Cling Grip, Ledge Grab, Clawline and Swift Step. Split Dash/Sprint keeps sprint unrestricted - Please note that the mappers are still working on adding split directions for their areas so not all areas support them fully yet, each update will further improve on this
# Minor / Bugfixes
* Some locations now no longer share the generic "Shell Shard Cache 1, 2, 3, etc" scheme and instead are given more discriptive names. The mappers are still working on renaming them all so please be patient * Added some missing UT maps, overall adjusted UT map marker positions * Fixed blacked-out passages in Memorium (Arborium_06) when entering from the left * Fixed fog obscuring Greymoor's hidden right entrance (Greymoor_02) * Fixed Greyroot giving no dialogue after completing her shuffled wish * Sylphsong now resumes during the same bench rest that removes a Cursed Crest Trap * Fixed missing randomized Shaman Crest Slot checks in Act 2 seeds * Fixed Craftmetal/Crest Slot generation repair bugs * Corrected unnecessary Act 3 gates for Khann and Nyleth * Fixed Pristine Core logic to require collecting Architect Crests location * Fixed completing Ecstasy of the End early making the Egg of Flealia check unavailable * Fixed duplicate Sherma when completing Balm for the Wounded before meeting him in Songclave * Fixed lingering Magma Bell HUD effects during Naked Trap, including while sizzling * Randomized Craw Summons now appears on the first eligible bench rest * Fixed Fleatopia Supplies appearing in logic before the caravan reaches Fleatopia * Fixed later Jubilana purchases appearing in logic before both rescues and her shop are available * Added Conjoined Heart to Old Heart randomization * Fixed the cursed crest blocking Eva and other required NPCs * Added Enter to connect from the Connection tab without clicking the button * Fixed Wish Shuffle marking Bone Bottom Supplies as available while Flick is still building the wish board * Fixed a rare DeathLink issue where an old connection could deliver a death after reconnecting or switching slots * Updated Fleatopia's minigame requirements * F4 warp can now be done in the main AP inventory page, the location can also be toggled between unlocked ones next to it * Prevented early Savage Beastfly wishes from removing Fourth Chorus's platforms before its defeat * Fixed KnockbackLink rejecting knockbacks because players' PC clocks differ * Fixed Fatal Resolve's wish offer appearing in logic before its required Act 3 shaman meeting * Corrected Silk and Soul logic for caravan progression, Flexile Spines and several wish-point contributions * Fixed shuffled wishes potentially blocking progression into Act 3 * Fixed Clawline allowing use of an unowned Drifter's Cloak * Fixed Drifter's Cloak wall-grabbing depending on visiting Cling Grip's original location * Boss Credits now explain their effects in the AP inventory * Phantom's Boss Credit now stops exhaust in the Organ, Underworks and Bilewater * Clearing the Mist and unlocking the lift still require defeat * Verdania stays open even after defeating the Clover Dancers * Added Palestag Boss Credit * Improved (idiot proofed) Craftmetal spending * Fixed Whispering Vaults’ bottom entrance incorrectly putting locations in logic before you could climb out of the entrance area * Fixed several locations incorrectly requiring Craw Lake completion or Clawline despite having another valid route * Reduced the delay before randomized flea rewards are sent * Adjusted Herobrine to only target players who have benchwarp installed * Removed Far Fields - Shell Shard Cache 8 and the inscription on First Sinner's door * Fixed the Mosshome Moss Plaque check becoming unavailable after using Needolin * Fixed uncollected Beast Shard rewards from Rhinogrund failing to return after leaving the room or dying * Fixed Bone Bottom, Bellhart and Songclave disappearing from F4 destinations in Act 3 * Fixed Whispering Vaults appearing reachable through the unopened Underworks elevator shortcut * Fixed duplicate handling of the Pilgrim's Rest Tool Pouch location * Wardenfly captures now count as routes into the Slab * Overworld Wardenflies no longer disappear because of Slab progress or Act 3 * Killed Wardenflies return when you leave and re-enter their room * Added Key of Indolent and Key of Heretic to Major Key randomization * Starting with Shaman or another later-act crest now keeps Hunter available in earlier-goal runs, including its randomized slot locations and items * Fixed excluded crest slots waiting for AP items that don’t exist * Fixed Nuu's scroll interaction staying disabled after her availability changes * Fixed Phantoms defeat not being recognized when evaluating their Citadel entrance

entry.title: DUSK v0.4.5
entry.content: ## Changes - More key logic: these levels now have mapped key rules, so checks that don’t need keys are in logic without them: - E1M5 - E1M6 - E2M1 (fully mapped: everything except Level Complete needs no keys, and Level Complete needs only the Red Key) - E2M3 - E2M4 - E2M6 - E2M7 - E3M1 - E3M2 - Together with E1M8 from 0.4.3, these levels no longer need every key for every check. Checks that haven’t been mapped yet still need all of their level’s keys. - Item requirements: checks can now also need a specific item. E3M1’s Super Shotgun now requires the Mortar. - Unneeded keys are filler: keys that no check needs, currently E2M1’s Blue and Yellow keys, are now filler instead of progression. This takes effect once seeds can start with only E1M1 unlocked. - E2M10 supply room removed: a hidden supply room at the far east of E2M10 that couldn’t be reached in play is no longer part of the randomizer. That’s 28 fewer checks, most of them ammo. It covers Super Shotgun 1, Riveter 1, Hallowed Health 1 and the Serum of Blistering Heat. E2M10’s remaining Super Shotgun, Riveter and Hallowed Health lose their number suffix. ## Notes - Update dusk.apworld. The mod ZIP only changes version number. - If your YAML lists E2M10 checks by name (for example in exclude_locations), check the renamed ones.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.3
entry.content: ## Changes ### Added - **`!ap loadout` equips weapons you don't own.** Pick a slot, then any weapon your class can hold in it. The list puts the weapons with the most Archipelago buffs first and shows how many each one has. Stock weapons are not listed, since you already have them: Reset at the end of the list puts your own weapon back. The choice lasts until you leave the server. It applies at once in the spawn room or between waves, otherwise at your next resupply. Slots the run has not unlocked stay locked. Upgrades you buy for the chosen weapon stay on it, the same as for a weapon from your backpack. We tested the weapon swaps and the upgrades on a server with a scripted player, but no real player has opened the menu yet. - **Nuke, next to Repair in Settings.** It deletes the game server, SteamCMD and the downloads, and the next start installs them again from nothing, 14 GB included. Repair keeps the game files; Nuke does not. The run and its checks, your settings, the player file and your community content folder stay. It asks before it does anything. ### Fixed - **Servers work on the TF2 update of 16 October 2026.** Windows SigMod servers no longer refuse to start or crash on every community mission, and the defender bots read item and attribute data correctly again on Windows and Linux. - **Windows SigMod servers play every community mission to the end.** The test servers now clear all 532 waves of the SigMod community missions. - **Spy stabs alert nearby robots** on Linux SigMod servers. - **The Your Eternal Reward unnerf works again on Linux.** The last TF2 update had broken it. - **More SigMod mods work on Windows servers:** 254 of the 309 mods now load in full. - **Caliginous Caper wave 666 no longer ends when the 64 Spies die.** Valve lists the tanks that wait for the Spies ahead of them, and the game ends the wave on the tick the last Spy dies, before the tanks, the crit robots and the Uber Medics that follow. The repaired file now lists each group after the ones it waits for. The server writes it again at start. - **Weapon buffs no longer pile up on Windows servers.** Each time the game rebuilt your buffs, the reserve ammo and the health you were holding went up by the buff again, and switching weapons rebuilds them twice. A +25% reserve ammo buff read 511, 797, 1243 and kept going, and a max health buff added its amount to your health every time. The buffs themselves were right. The plugin now puts back the ammo and health a rebuild raised. It does not top up your ammo or health when you first earn a buff; the next resupply does that. The Linux server we measured did not do this. We ran ten rebuilds in a row on a Windows and a Linux server with scripted defender bots, but no real player has checked it yet. - **Windows servers run on the 2026-10-14 TF2 update.** The update moved the game code SigMod patches, and a SigMod built for the old game refuses to load on the new one. The Windows launcher now installs a SigMod built for TF2 11117211. Missions that need SigMod load again. - **Windows SigMod servers no longer crash when bots use items or when a mission is cleared.** A bot using an item (a canteen, say) could crash the server, and so could clearing a mission with a thousand robots or more. Both came from game functions the Windows SigMod had not found. We played the missions on a Windows server with scripted defender bots; all but one mission played through, and that one still stops at its first wave. - **More SigMod mods work on a Windows server.** Weapon effects, death yells and entity limits did nothing there, because the Windows SigMod had not found the game functions they hook. They now run. We played the missions on a Windows server with scripted defender bots: five of eight groups played through. Three missions still lose waves (Dismal Devilry, Dust to Dust and Trespasser Remaster) and are being looked at. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(ci): hand the release and the nightly the extensions they now need by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/221 * chore(release): 1.18.3 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/222 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.2...v1.18.3 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZTVlYTA2MGNiMmYwODFjNDE3ZGJiYzE5Yzg1ZWUyOTc6MTc5MjM1NjAwMg==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/YmUwOTdmNzVlOTgxMDM4MWQ0YzVmMDMyNmMxNDE5ZTI6MTc5MjM1NjAwNQ==/detection)

entry.title: Mario Tennis GBC v0.2.0
entry.content:
## New options
- **`shot_items`** (default off): your shots become items. - **Strokes:** topspin, slice and the flat shot. The second copy of each adds its power shot (the smash, for the flat shot). - **Lob and drop shot.** - **Serves:** topspin, slice and flat. The second copy adds the nice serve. - You start with one random stroke and one random serve. A locked shot plays the first stroke or serve you own. - **Logic:** - Story matches want more shots as you climb: 3 for Senior, 5 for Varsity, 8 for the Island Open, 11 for the Dream Match. - Shot-hungry mini-games and drills want the shots they need. - Anything that can still be won without the shots shows as glitched logic in Universal Tracker. - **`experience_modifier`** (default normal): scales every EXP award, from ×0.5 up to ×5. That covers story, exhibition and linked matches, drills, and EXP Bundles. - **`nerf_two_on_one`** (default off): Bowser's Two-on-One plays 2 games per set instead of 6. - **`skip_ceremony`** (default off): winning the Island Open final skips the fireworks and the Awards Ceremony. You go straight from the bracket to the congratulations artwork and credits. - **`dream_match_difficulty`** (default intense): sets how hard Mario plays in Peach's first Dream Match offer: hard, intense or max. After a win she offers all three, as usual.
## Locations
- **New:** each class's practice match, in both arcs (6 locations). Each one still needs that class's pass. - **Removed:** the three mini-game record-court locations. - That makes 88 locations in total.
## Logic
- **Mini-games:** - Perfect Shot needs the lob. - Target Shot levels 2 and 3 need the drop shot, and want the lob. - Two-on-One wants the Dream Match's shot count. - **Drills:** a level's logic includes the level before it. Service Matches want a nice serve, and are glitched without one.
## Other changes to the game
- **Academy front gate:** once both the Island Open and Peach's Castle are open, the gate opens an Island Open / Mario World menu. Pressing B walks you back into the Academy. - **Assigning EXP:** - Select gives the highlighted character all the remaining EXP. - Holding the increase keeps speeding up, past the original game's top speed, to as much as 64 points a frame.

entry.title: Spyro 2 v2.2.0
entry.content:
This release modifies both the Duckstation client (S2AP.Desktop.exe) and the APWorld (including the Bizhawk client). This release is not compatible with previous versions. As this release patches a significant DataStorage usage issue with the Duckstation client, full gemsanity players are urged to update immediately.
New Features: - Players can now menu out of Glimmer before entering Summer Forest for the first time. - Game overs prior to entering Summer Forest continue to redirect the player to Glimmer, as in vanilla.
Changes: - The minimum supported AP version is now 0.6.6, up from 0.6.1. - Most users will no longer need to run the Duckstation client in admin mode. This is no longer forced on opening it. - Gemsanity Rework - Gem locations and items are now separated. - The player may specify how many gems to become locations. - Gems will behave normally if only locations are added. - Adding 500 or more locations requires host approval. - Simplified gem item options. - When choosing gem bundles or full gemsanity, the player's gem location count may be overridden to provide enough locations. - If not logically required, red gems are now filler items. Otherwise, they are converted to green and blue gems. - This significantly improves the speed of generation and success rate for full gemsanity. - When Level Locks are on, beating Ripto unlocks Dragon Shores permanently. - The lock now only prevents entering from out of bounds. - The trick enabling wall access from Zephyr with Double Jump now also grants access to the two gems outside Metro Speedway into logic. (Coded by PhoenixAki)
Bug Fixes - [Duckstation] Fixed a critical bug where inefficient DataStorage use could cause issues up to and including crashes in full gemsanity seeds. - Fixed a logic error that incorrectly handled the warp from Crush to Autumn Plains when the player had swim but not climb. - [Bizhawk] Fixed a pair of bugs around Sparx range and the Lazy Sparx Trap. - Fixed a bug where loading into an in-progress gemsanity seed could release checks based on your vanilla progression instead of your AP progression. - [Duckstation] Fixed a bug where connecting before in game could cause filler items received offline to be lost. - Fixed a bug where Elora could let the player into the Ripto fight early under rare circumstances.

entry.title: Baldur's Gate 3 v0.8.0
entry.content:
Baldur's Gate 3 Archipelago Version 0.8.0 BETA:
Release of Act 3! Support for Questsanity, Killsanity and Containersanity. Questsanity has been untested. Block Entrances has been untested. I make no guarantees either option is even playable. I have used the ap_out of my successful run to run as test verification against killsanity and containersanity, so those should at least be playable, but I have not done much examination regarding what kills/containers may exist in alternative configurations of act 3's events.
Also included in this release: * Changed default yaml to be Killsanity instead of Questsanity * Removed Sync Method from the yaml options (after the 0.7.0 revamp it wasn't very relevant) * Improved some documentation (options have location count updates, a warning on Confusion traps, revamped the setup docs to treat this release as source of truth) * Fixed a logic glitch that would force Underwell access too early * Fixed the "Find Benryn" location to have more triggers * Renamed "Nightsong: Enter Underdark" to "... through Temple" since apparently it only triggers that direction. * Minor fixes to Act 1+2 containersanity * Filtered out summons from killsanity logs because they're never locations and the @$#%@#% wizards in act 3 spam like nothing * Fixed the Waypoint lockout- Act 2 Shar Trials and Act 3 should no longer remove waypoints from the waypoint list. I _don't_ know how successful this is at actually being able to visit old waypoints and accomplishing things, but it seemed like a good start. * Some mild revamps to the container highlight aura for optimization.

entry.title: DOOM Eternal v0.6.5
entry.content:
# DOOM Eternal Archipelago v0.6.5
## Gameplay and item delivery
- Fixed the Unmaykr check still triggering when inserting a single or more (less than all of them) Empyrean Key. The check waits until you collect the weapon. - Fixed DeathLink stopping both incoming and outgoing deaths after cancelling a pending death. - Mission completion checks keep updating if DeathLink encounters an error. - Prevented leftover mission checks from a previous room from completing missions in a new room. - Fixed Weapon Upgrade Points blocking later item deliveries when local delivery history was missing. Recovery accounts for points already received without refunding spent points. - Fixed a Windows item-delivery error affecting drives such as exFAT.
## Launcher and save recovery
- Improved recovery for usable AP saves incorrectly reported as corrupted. - Added an automatic local backup before attempting to resume an existing AP save. - Added save details and **Copy details** under **AP SAVE**, plus an option to back up available local files with the game closed. - Support reports include more information about missing or inaccessible save files. - Added **SELECT PROTON** shortcuts in Session and Help. Saving a valid selection retries preparation for the connected room. - Improved session startup, communication and shutdown on Linux/Proton, including CachyOS.
## APWorld — newly generated rooms only
**The APWorld determines mission order, item placements and progression rules when you generate a room. The changes below require a new room generated with APWorld v0.6.5.**
- Fixed progression getting stuck with **Vanilla Order + Full Saga + Kill the Icon of Sin**. Final Sin stays at the end of the campaign. - Fixed some randomized campaigns placing items needed for their opening missions too late. - Prevented DLC Only campaigns from starting at The Dark Lord when that start could block progression. - Fixed progression involving The Crucible with DLC content disabled, including the requirement to complete all mission challenges. - Removed the obsolete **DLC Logic Timing** option and its From the Beginning/Late Game choices. DLC missions use their individual equipment and combat requirements.
**Existing rooms keep their original mission order, item placements and generation rules. Updating the launcher or installing the new APWorld does not apply these generation fixes to an existing room.**
## Updating from v0.6.4
Close DOOM and the old launcher, extract the complete v0.6.5 package into a new folder, update to **Sentinel Core 1.0.7**, and reconnect to the same room and slot. Rebuild the room package when prompted.
**You can keep your compatible v0.6.x room and AP save for the gameplay, launcher and recovery fixes. No save reset is required.**

entry.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood v0.1.7
entry.content: This update fixes several crafting and item-delivery issues, expands weapon upgrades, and improves playing with Archipelago disabled. Rejoice vanilla enjoyers! **Crafting and progression** - Fixed weapon-material and blueprint crates appearing already opened when you owned their reward through another source. Owning a Rusty Spring, for example, no longer prevents collecting its crate’s location check. - Corrected Crafting mode blueprint rewards. A weapon blueprint now grants only its blueprint, while its crafting material remains a separate item. Starting with both grants one of each. - Added recovery for missing blueprints you previously received through Archipelago. Recipes already learned at the blacksmith remain recognized without repeatedly restoring paper blueprints. - Fixed a potential Crafting mode progression lock. Shotgun access now accounts for completing A Heart for Poochie and reaching the Bones needed for crafting in Where Rock Bleeds. - Heartglaze Flower can no longer be placed at Quest Complete: Old Warfare in Crafting mode. - Updated tracker explanations to reflect the corrected shotgun crafting requirements. **Weapon upgrades** - Added Pistol upgrade support. - All six weapons now have **three separate upgrades** available: Pistol, Shotgun, Sniper Rifle, Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher, and Crossbow. - Both Direct and Crafting modes now contain **18 weapon upgrades total**. These replace filler items without adding more location checks. - Upgrades received before obtaining a weapon are held until that weapon is acquired or crafted. - Fixed upgrade handling that could apply the same received upgrades more than once during recovery or reconnecting. **Item delivery and recovery** - Fixed missing or heavily delayed item deliveries, including starting Viscera, ingredients, key items, and weapon upgrades. - Improved delivery during loading and save transitions so items wait until the active run is ready. - Fixed Recent AP Activity failing to display received items and completed locations. - Fixed an issue where finding an item at its original vanilla location could remove the newly received Archipelago reward. This affected Fogg’s Drumsticks and could affect other quest items. - Improved recovery of previously received items while respecting quest items already turned in and blueprints already learned. **Playing with AP Off** - Fixed vanilla rewards being blocked while Archipelago was disabled. - AP Off now bypasses randomizer item handling, progression repairs, location reporting, and DeathLink behavior. - Randomizer cutscene skips are ignored while AP is disabled, including the Jakob death scene. - Archipelago Viscera protection settings no longer override vanilla money-bag behavior in AP Off. - AP gameplay overlays remain hidden while playing with Archipelago disabled. **Performance and presentation** - Reduced unnecessary overlay and title-screen updates while keeping item delivery running independently. - Disabled repetitive map-visibility logging by default to reduce unnecessary background work. - Added elapsed timestamps to Recent AP Activity so players can distinguish when events occurred. - Styled activity timestamps in a muted slate gray to keep the focus on item and location messages. **Updating** Plenty of optimization and performance improvements, so it's highly recommend to update if you are currently playing on an older version. You only need to update the `APWorld` and `LaikaMod.dll` file as always. That's all for now! I apologize Crafting mode enjoyers for making you have to wait, but I hope these new quality of life changes make it worth it. As always, please report any further issues in in the Laika Discord channel on the Archipelago Discord!

entry.title: Dragon Quest IX v0.2.0
entry.content:
# Dragon Quest IX - Beta Release (Version 0.2.0)
**This is a beta release. Things can possibly break, though the core gameplay should run normally.**
*This requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer!*** *This **is not** compatible with seeds generated on an earlier version*
New to the game? Check out the [FAQ](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1427594624389742716/1491731616068800543) ## Bugs fixed
* Removed DLC only location "Stornway Castle - Cellar"
## New Feature: Shop Randomization
After a lot of trial and error, and with help of the Ap community, Shop Randomization is here! You can choose from the following options, how much / if you want to randomize shops: * "None" => Do not randomize Shops * "Same Shop Type" => Shops of the same type are randomized * "Same Region" => Shops in the same region are randomized * "Same Shop Type And Region" => Shops of the same type and in the same region are randomized * "True Random" => All Shops get randomized together
Generation may fail <1% of the time, in such a case just try again :)
## New Feature and Change: Patch Files
Dragon Quest IX now also makes use of a patch file to put it's data into the game where it is possible. When generation, you will find a `.apdqix` file in the output - open it via the "Open Patch" Option in the launcher, or just double click it from your Downloads.
This will ask for your copy of the game as well as the EmuHawk executable, if not already set form playing other games. Once set up, it automatically runs BizHawk with the patched ROM - have fun!
If you continue your run later, just re-open the modified ROM, which should be placed in the same folder where you have your original ROM.
